notes.title: Clarifying release date
notes.notes: [p]Hi folks! Thank you to everyone who's helped LEO get this far - the launch is super close and it's an exciting time! There was a small mixup on the launch date - the earliest I can hit Release is the midnight of June 30th, but unfortunately the displayed launch time was 12:00pm. Sorry for the extra wait! I'm very excited for you all to play it in 12 hours![/p][p][/p][p]On a personal note, this is my first time doing a Steam release - I'm hoping it'll go as smoothly as possible, but I'll be around and ready to fix any issues that crop up! I welcome any feedback if things aren't working as they should![/p]
